rv.q: If, as Sinyor says in his programme notes, we all need to learn to laugh at God, this certainly isn’t the place to start.
It is also patchy, childish and overlong, and it ultimately collapses under the weight of its own – and our – expectations.
NotMoses is funny and fun, but like the speed of its one liners it’s easily forgotten.

cn.t: Biblical comedy aspires to Life of Brian heights but falls short, with critics finding the satirical humor dated and lacking the sharp wit of its Monty Python inspiration.
